page.title: GPU Dictionary Generator
page.description: Generate a dictionary of simulated EBSD patterns on the GPU from an EMsoft master pattern. Stand-alone tool — does not touch the main indexing pipeline.

generate.tooltip: Start GPU generation of a simulated EBSD pattern dictionary from the master pattern.

errors.detectorIntegers: Detector H and W must be integers.
errors.resolutionPositive: Resolution must be a positive number.
errors.noTaskId: Backend did not return a task_id.

master.inputTooltip: Paste the full file path to an EMsoft master pattern HDF5 (.h5) file.
master.useTooltip: Commit the entered master pattern path (only shown when a commit handler is wired).
master.hint: Paste a full path to an EMsoft master pattern HDF5 file. The dictionary is generated on the GPU from this master + the detector settings below.

detector.heightTooltip: Detector pattern height in pixels (rows). Range 16–2048.
detector.widthTooltip: Detector pattern width in pixels (columns). Range 16–2048.
detector.pcxTooltip: Pattern Center x-coordinate (PCx), fractional 0–1 across the detector width.
detector.pcyTooltip: Pattern Center y-coordinate (PCy), fractional 0–1 across the detector height.
detector.pczTooltip: Pattern Center z / detector distance (PCz), fractional 0–1.
detector.sampleTiltTooltip: Sample tilt angle in degrees (typically 70 for EBSD). Range 0–90.

orientation.sliderTooltip: SO(3) orientation sampling step in degrees; lower = more orientations, larger dictionary.
orientation.numberTooltip: Exact orientation sampling resolution in degrees. 5 deg coarse, 1–2 deg production.
orientation.normalizeTooltip: Zero-mean / unit-variance normalize each generated pattern before storing.
orientation.hint: Lower resolution → more orientations → larger dictionary. 5° is typical for a coarse first pass; drop to 1–2° for production runs.

list.refreshTooltip: Reload the list of GPU-generated dictionaries from disk.
list.empty: No dictionaries yet. Generate one above.
list.deleteTooltip: Delete this dictionary file from disk (asks for confirmation; cannot be undone).
